Proposition
[$\mu $ controls volume ratios] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0402, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0403 ↗ def:chow-ii-appd-perelman-invariants 1. appD:D.44\group Volume Ratios

For every $\rho >0$ there is $C_2(n,\rho )$ such that, if $r\leq \rho $ and $\operatorname {Ric}\geq -c_1(n)r^{-2}$ and $R\leq c_1(n)r^{-2}$ on $B(p,r)$ in a closed Riemannian manifold $(\widehat{\mathcal M},\hat g)$, then \[ \mu (\hat g,r^2)\leq \log \frac{\operatorname {Vol}B(p,r)}{r^n}+C_2(n,\rho ). \]
